# Figures

> Figures is a digital marketing agency in Los Angeles for creators with something to sell. It runs paid ads on Meta, Google and TikTok, provides creative direction, designs brand identities and websites, produces content, manages social accounts, and provides strategy and reporting. Figures is a division of Scheibe Advisory LLC (California).

Facts worth getting right:
- On paid ads, Figures is paid an agreed share of the sales the ads bring in. If the ads bring in no sales, Figures earns no fee on them.
- Content production and social media management run on a flat monthly fee quoted after an introductory call. Creative direction is quoted per project or as part of a monthly fee. Branding and website packages are priced per project and quoted before work starts. Strategy and reporting are included with ads, content or social work.
- Clients pay ad spend directly to the ad platforms. Figures does not hold client ad budgets.
- How sales are attributed is agreed in writing before any campaign launches.
- Figures does not guarantee results.
- Figures works with creators who already sell something: their own products, affiliate offers, subscriptions or memberships, or services such as coaching.
- The process is: a two-minute application, a 15-minute call, a written plan and terms, then launch.
- Contact: info@wearefigures.com, (310) 279-0405, Los Angeles. No street address is published.

## Pages
- [Home](https://wearefigures.com/): Figures is a digital marketing agency in Los Angeles for creators with something to sell. Paid ads, content and social. On ads, we only make money when you do.
- [Paid ads](https://wearefigures.com/paid-ads): Paid ads for creators on Meta, Google and TikTok. Figures builds and runs the campaigns and takes a share of the sales they generate. No sales, no fee.
- [Creative direction](https://wearefigures.com/creative-direction): Creative direction for creators: the look, the concepts and the art direction behind your content, launches and ads, so it all looks like one brand.
- [Branding and websites](https://wearefigures.com/branding-websites): No logo or website you're happy with yet? Figures designs your brand, with three logo directions and full guidelines, and builds the website to match.
- [Content](https://wearefigures.com/content): Content production for creators: ideas, scripts, shoot days in Los Angeles and edits, made for your feed first and then cut again for ads.
- [Social management](https://wearefigures.com/social-media-management): Social media management for creators. Figures handles the calendar, posting, captions and comments every week, so your accounts stay active while you work.
- [Strategy and reporting](https://wearefigures.com/strategy-reporting): Strategy and reporting for creators who sell. Figures reviews your offer and funnel, builds one plan, and reports on sales, cost and profit in plain words.
- [Services](https://wearefigures.com/services): What Figures does for creators: paid ads, creative direction, branding and websites, content, social media management, and strategy and reporting.
- [About](https://wearefigures.com/about): Figures is a digital marketing agency in Los Angeles built on one idea: judge us by what you sold, not what we posted. A division of Scheibe Advisory LLC.
- [FAQ](https://wearefigures.com/faq): Straight answers about Figures: who we work with, how the share of sales works on ads, who pays for ad spend, and what happens after you apply.
- [Apply](https://wearefigures.com/apply): Apply to work with Figures in about two minutes. Tell us who you are, what you sell and which services you need. The next step is a 15-minute call.
- [Contact](https://wearefigures.com/contact): Contact Figures in Los Angeles. Email info@wearefigures.com or call (310) 279-0405. Want to work with us? The application takes two minutes.

- [Terms](https://wearefigures.com/terms): Terms for using wearefigures.com. Figures is a division of Scheibe Advisory LLC. Client work is governed by a separate signed agreement.
- [Accessibility](https://wearefigures.com/accessibility): Figures aims to make wearefigures.com usable by everyone and works toward WCAG 2.2 AA. Tell us about any barrier and we will fix it.
